responsibility: This header declares the interrupt-vector management interface used by GNU Modula-2 coroutine support in mc-boot. It exports constructors for input, output, and timer vectors; routines to rearm timers, attach payloads, include or exclude vectors from dispatch, listen for pending interrupts above a priority threshold, and force initialization, defining the public event-dispatch API on top of RTco and Selective.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration side of GRTint: it exports the constructors and control operations for input, output, and timer vectors plus Listen/Init, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GRTint.cc contains the actual queue management and select-driven interrupt dispatch implementation.
